tagline: 宝丽来旁轴相机，1967 年发布
description:
Part of the series of Polaroid cameras that began with the Automatic Land Camera 100 and finishing at the Automatic Land Camera 450, the Polaroid Land Model 230 shares with all models in this line:
* Folding bellows
* Automatic exposure
* 100-series Packfilm

The 230 is one of the cheaper 'consumer'
